text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,<n>Grass Wonder
tells me there's<n>somewhere she wants to visit, so
we<n>stop by an inn.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone. It's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's Grass! Long time no see!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hi, Grass! What are we gonna play<n>today?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A warm smile grows across Grass<n>Wonder's face
as the excited<n>children flock around her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they're the children of this inn's<n>proprietors.
They're very<n>knowledgeable about traditional
Japanese games.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We bonded over a game of otedama<n>the last time I
visited.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
We played lots and lots! We did<n>ohajiki, ayatori,
karuta, and tons<n>more.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We sure did. Learning so many new<n>things was fun
for me, as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So, what shall we do today?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I think we probably showed<n>you all the
games we know already.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Why don't you teach us a<n>game you
played when you were<n>little?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? Me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But... I didn't really get to play any<n>Japanese
games when I was young.<n>What to do?
choice_data_list: What types of games did you play in the States?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What types? Well... it's just that I'm<n>not sure if
these children would really<n>enjoy—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Oh, I forgot! You're from America!<n>That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I wanna know what you<n>play in
America!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Very well... I guess I do know a game<n>called Simon
Says.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Simon?! What a cool name!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I guess it would have some<n>flair for being
foreign.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
America and Japan. I wouldn't be<n>who I am today
without them both.
choice_data_list: Tell us more about the United States.
Tell us more about the United States.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
America and Japan. I wouldn't be<n>who I am today
without them both.
choice_data_list: Tell us more about the United States.
Tell us more about the United States.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Sure. So, in this game, one person<n>plays the role of
"Simon," and<n>everyone else has to do what Simon
says.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Experience is the best teacher. I'll<n>start, and you
can follow my lead.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Oh yes. Simon says, righthand up...

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: But I don't know English!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I guess I got too excited about<n>sharing something
from back home...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The four of us play together until the<n>sun goes
down, and I get to learn a<n>lot about Grass
Wonder's feelings<n>toward her home country.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Gladly. There's so much I could tell<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My father fits the typical image of a<n>confident,
rough-around-the-edges<n>American, but he loves
Japan dearly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile my mother is the polar
opposite—unfailingly gentle and polite.<n>She's
something of a role model for<n>me, actually.
choice_data_list: You take after both of them.
You take after both of them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Perhaps I do.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hey! Can we play now?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry. Yes, let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I can tell you more on the<n>way back to the
academy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We play until the sun goes down.<n>Later, as we're
returning to the<n>academy, she tells me all about her
happy memories from back home.
